advisor.title: Ask about any build
advisor.descriptionGeneral: Ask about hardware, compatibility or value. Recommendations come straight from the catalogue.
advisor.descriptionBuild: Answers grounded in your current {{count}}-part build, with live catalogue lookups.
advisor.welcomeTitle: Ask me to build you a PC
advisor.welcomeBody: Budget, resolution, the apps you use — the more context, the better the answer.
advisor.welcome: I'm your build advisor. Tell me a budget and what you do with your machine, or ask about the build you're working on. I'll only recommend parts that exist in the catalogue.
advisor.placeholderGeneral: e.g. $2,000 for 4K gaming with quiet acoustics…
advisor.placeholderBuild: Ask about your build — e.g. “can I upgrade the GPU without a new PSU?”
advisor.composerHint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line · recommendations come from the live catalogue

smartBuilder.title: Describe it. We'll spec it.
smartBuilder.description: Tell us the budget and the workload. The agent searches the live catalogue, checks compatibility and scores every candidate before it answers.
smartBuilder.purpose: What will you use it for?
smartBuilder.resolutionHint: This changes how much of the budget the GPU deserves.
smartBuilder.preferencesHint: Optional — pick as many as you like.
smartBuilder.notesHint: Games you play, software you run, parts you already own.
smartBuilder.notesPlaceholder: e.g. I mostly play Cyberpunk and CS2, I already have a monitor, I want it to be quiet.
smartBuilder.emptyBody: Every part is pulled from the catalogue and verified by the compatibility engine — the advisor cannot invent a component.

doctor.title: Build Doctor
doctor.description: A grounded diagnosis: compatibility, sub-scores and the upgrades that actually raise the score.
doctor.upgradesHint: Ranked by score gained per dollar, computed against the live catalogue.
doctor.noUpgrades: Nothing in the catalogue would raise this build's score within budget.
doctor.disclaimer: Scores and compatibility are computed deterministically from catalogue data. The narrative review is written by Gemini from those numbers.
doctor.loadError: That build could not be found.

aiStatus.title: AI status
aiStatus.configureBody: Add your key to .env and restart the dev server:
aiStatus.offlineHint: The rule-based builder works without any AI connection.
